# predecéssor-dps

> Self-hosted Next.js app for Predecessor hero stats / DPS, fed from Pred.gg data. Deployed via Dokploy (image `ghcr.io/mestryx-dev/predecessor`, port 3010). Chat French, durable files English. There is no `docs/` tree by design.

## Root

- [README.md](README.md): Repository overview — setup, env, deployment
- [PLAN.md](PLAN.md): Development plan — roadmap and feature notes
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Agent guide — change protocol, stack, WorkSpace context

## App

- [app/page.tsx](app/page.tsx): Main page — hero stats / DPS UI
- [app/layout.tsx](app/layout.tsx): Root layout
- [lib/prisma.ts](lib/prisma.ts): Prisma client singleton
- [lib/ensure-db.ts](lib/ensure-db.ts): Database bootstrap / ensure logic

## Data & scripts

- [prisma/schema.prisma](prisma/schema.prisma): Prisma schema — heroes, stats, matches
- [prisma/migrations/](prisma/migrations/): Database migrations
- [scripts/fetchMatches.ts](scripts/fetchMatches.ts): Pred.gg data fetch script
- [scripts/processMatches.ts](scripts/processMatches.ts): Match processing script

## Optional

- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): Container build for Dokploy deployment
- [docker-entrypoint.sh](docker-entrypoint.sh): Container entrypoint
- [.env.example](.env.example): Environment variables template
